title: Specialist - Architecture
description:
**Role description**

**Role Overview**  
We are looking for an experienced Senior AI Engineer with strong Google Cloud Platform experience and preferably a healthcare domain background The ideal candidate will design develop and support secure scalable cloud native healthcare applications while leveraging Google Vertex AI and AI assisted engineering practices to improve delivery speed code quality and solution intelligence.

**Key Responsibilities**  
Build and deploy cloud native applications on Google Cloud Platform using services such as Cloud Run Cloud Functions Pub Sub Cloud Storage and managed databases  
Integrate Google Vertex AI capabilities into healthcare applications including generative AI model endpoints prompt based workflows and intelligent automation use cases  
Apply responsible AI and vibe coding practices to accelerate development improve developer productivity and support rapid prototyping while ensuring code quality security and maintainability  
Collaborate with product owners architects business analysts QA DevOps and healthcare stakeholders to translate business and clinical requirements into technical solutions  
Ensure application designs and data handling practices align with healthcare security privacy and compliance expectations including protection of PHI PII and HIPAA aligned controls  
Participate in code reviews unit testing integration testing CICD automation performance tuning production support and incident resolution  
Contribute to architecture discussions reusable frameworks technical documentation and engineering best practices across delivery teams  
Required Skills and Experience  
Min 10 years of hands on software engineering experience with strong backend development expertise  
Hands on experience with Google Cloud Platform services and cloud native application development  
Practical experience using Google Vertex AI or related AIML platforms for generative AI model integration embeddings prompt workflows or intelligent automation  
Experience with CICD pipelines Git based source control automated testing containerization and DevOps practices  
Healthcare domain experience including familiarity with payer provider pharmacy claims clinical patient engagement or healthcare data platforms  
Understanding of healthcare data privacy PHI PII handling HIPAA aligned security controls auditability and production support expectations  
Ability to use AI assisted development or vibe coding approaches responsibly validating generated code for correctness reliability security and maintainability  
Preferred Qualifications  
Experience with healthcare interoperability standards such as HL7 FHIR EDI X12 or similar healthcare integration patterns  
Knowledge of BigQuery Dataflow Cloud Composer Apigee Kubernetes Terraform Jenkins GitHub Actions or observability tools  
Experience working in Agile or SAFe delivery environments with distributed onshore offshore teams  
Strong communication skills with the ability to explain technical designs risks and tradeoffs to business and technology stakeholders.

**Good to Have**  
Design develop and maintain enterprise grade backend services using Java Spring Boot REST APIs and microservices architecture  
Strong proficiency in object oriented design and secure coding practices

 **Skills**

**Mandatory Skills :** AI/Generative AI, GCP AI Services, GCP Vertex AI  
**Good to Have Skills :** Java, Microservices, SpringBoot

title: Quality Engineering Arch Senior Analyst
description:
**Skill required:** Tech for Operations - Automated Testing  
**Designation:** QA Engineer  
**Qualifications:**Post Graduate in any discipline
  
**Years of Experience:**5 to 8 years
  
**About Accenture**  
Accenture is a global professional services company with leading capabilities in digital, cloud and security.Combining unmatched experience and specialized skills across more than 40 industries, we offer Strategy and Consulting, Technology and Operations services, and Accenture Song— all powered by the world’s largest network of Advanced Technology and Intelligent Operations centers. Our 784,000 people deliver on the promise of technology and human ingenuity every day, serving clients in more than 120 countries. We embrace the power of change to create value and shared success for our clients, people, shareholders, partners and communities.Visit us at www.accenture.com
  
**What would you do?** Our Service Supply Chain offering combines proprietary technology with client systems to design, execute, and deliver BPaaS and managed services across the Plan, Deliver, and Recover lifecycle. As a Business SME, you will partner with business development to shape resilient solutions that improve clients supply chains and customer experience. Join us to drive meaningful impact and build what is next. The QA Engineer is a detail-oriented, motivated individual who works with a team will ensure the highest levels of quality assurance for our software applications. The QA Engineer will be responsible for designing, implementing, and running QA processes including automatic testing, test planning and defect tracking. The ideal candidate is a person experienced with creating repeatable and scalable testing solutions along with tracking and reporting on test result  
**What are we looking for?** • Proven experience in software development projects in various lifecycle phases include design, build, implementation, and steady state. • Minimum of 5 years of experience in working as a QA engineer. • Proven experience in writing testing cases, plans and test schedules. • Key Skills- Python, Java, SQL, Postman, REST API automation testing, Playwright, Selenium, Azure Test Plan • Experience with testing functional and non-functional components. • Strong experience with implementing and managing automated testing tools. • Experience with automated reporting and live monitoring of test cases. • Postman (Software) - P2 • REST API Testing - P2 • Playwright - P2
  
**Roles and Responsibilities:** • Lead and support the development of frameworks and operating models for building out test cases, plans and schedules. • Design, build and implement automated testing tools and workflows. • Develop standards and metrics for measuring testing success or failures. • Work closely with engineering teams to incorporate testing into both code and data pipelines. • Create detailed and well-structured test plans and test cases. • Conduct root cause analysis activities and risk analysis. • Estimate, prioritize and plan testing activities. • Drive innovation and streamline the overall testing process. • Lead and support testing of multiple applications and dataset simultaneously • Track quality assurance metrics such as defect densities and open defect counts • Understand business needs and objectives. • Maintain strict data security controls and standards. • Adhere to data management best practices and maintain detailed documentation.

  
Post Graduate in any discipline

title: Engineer I, Software Quality Assurance Testing
description:
**About Xerox Holdings Corporation**
  

For more than 100 years, Xerox has continually redefined the workplace experience. Harnessing our leadership position in office and production print technology, we’ve expanded into software and services to sustainably power the hybrid workplace of today and tomorrow. Today, Xerox is continuing its legacy of innovation to deliver client\-centric and digitally\-driven technology solutions and meet the needs of today’s global, distributed workforce. From the office to industrial environments, our differentiated business and technology offerings and financial services are essential workplace technology solutions that drive success for our clients. At Xerox, we make work, work. Learn more about us at www.xerox.com.
  

Purpose:
  

* Responsible for strategy and design of controls system (hardware, software, telecommunications, infrastructure and/or information), testing strategy, standards and practices for enterprise, major organization or major platform. May define and manage project deliverables and work with the platform Centers of Competence (architecture, infrastructure \& production support) teams ensuring adherence to processes and coherence standards. In the area of quality \- responsible for managing application of appropriate quality and/or environmental management and process improvement techniques for a function or process. Develops, maintains, controls distribution of quality standards. Manages quality/testing of 3rd party partners.

  

Scope:
  

General:
  

* Performs routine assignments in entry level of the professional career band

  

* Typically a graduate, although may have progressed into the role via equivalent business experience that provide knowledge and exposure to fundamental, theories, principles, and concepts

  

* Professional roles will typically require a degree in their specific discipline which may apply to specific positions.

  

* Receives instruction, guidance and direction from others

  

* Limited decision making authority guided by policies, procedures, and business operations protocol
